'''Elgit''' was a minor trade [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Elgit system/Legends|Elgit system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region<ref name="EAOC" /> and lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called [[the Dead Road]], which connected it to the planets of [[Zisia]] and [[Usk (planet)|Usk]]. The [[Elgit–M'Hanna Corridor]] linked Elgit to the world of [[Sakifwanna]],<ref name="LoNH" /> and the trade planet was also joined by a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route to the [[Gos Hutta system/Legends|Gos Hutta system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Elgit served as a clearinghouse for goods that were reserved for the ''[[Bootana Hutta/Legends|Bootana Hutta]]'' region of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Realspace/Legends|Space]],<ref name="TEA" /> and the hyperlanes leading to Elgit were periodically patrolled by the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Troonol]], a member of the Hutt [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Elgit was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square T-10.<ref name="TEA" />
